description: Writes a grown tree into an SVG already on the page, reframing the viewBox to match. Lives outside the Astro script tag so it is reachable from vitest: the new tree rarely has the same segment count as the one the server drew, so every call reuses, clones or removes path elements. Surplus paths are cloned from the server's own path, keeping stroke styling defined in exactly one place.
name: applyTreeGrowth

description: Assembles a mailto: URL from a recipient and optional subject and body, percent-encoding each part.
name: buildMailto

untestabilityReason.justification: assembles a URL string from its arguments with no branching beyond omitting absent optional parts

description: The dragon curve: a right-angle fold repeated, walked as an orthogonal lattice that never self-intersects.
name: dragonPoints

description: Escapes interpolated values before they reach the worker's HTML responses.
name: escapeHtml

untestabilityReason.justification: Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay scaffolded by the CMS CLI; runs only on Workers and is unused here (auth.worker is false)

description: Builds the Fibonacci square spiral the way the sequence is built: each side is the sum of the previous two, attached to the growing box on a rotating side. Returns the largest square separately so it can be drawn open.
name: fibonacciTiling

description: Reads the editable navigation singleton per call, for the same reason getSettings does.
name: getNav

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read of a JSON singleton; the resolution order it depends on is covered by contentRoot tests

description: Reads the editable site-settings singleton per call rather than at module scope, so a scenario that seeds new settings is visible without restarting the dev server.
name: getSettings

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read of a JSON singleton; the resolution order it depends on is covered by contentRoot tests

description: Grows a tree for a seed that passes isAcceptableTree, resampling from a derived seed when it does not. A raw draw only passes about a third of the time, so the budget is 20 rather than a handful. Falls back to the CLOSEST attempt by shortfall rather than throwing, since this runs inside a page render where nobody can catch an exception.
name: growAcceptableTree

description: Grows the branching structure and returns the geometry plus the two facts acceptance needs that the segment list cannot answer: how many limbs grew, and whether the named bare limb was ever reached. treeSegments is now exactly its segments field, so the older signature and its tests are untouched.
name: growTree

description: Handles the password form POST in the OAuth relay.
name: handlePasswordSubmit

untestabilityReason.justification: Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay scaffolded by the CMS CLI; runs only on Workers and is unused here (auth.worker is false)

description: Renders the OAuth handshake page returned to the popup.
name: handshakePage

untestabilityReason.justification: Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay scaffolded by the CMS CLI; runs only on Workers and is unused here (auth.worker is false)

description: Turns a page slug into a tree seed with FNV-1a. This is what makes the per-page axis free: about, contact and a page written next year each hash to their own number, so each grows its own tree with no code change. Stable across builds and platforms, because an unstable hash would redraw every committed screenshot on every deploy.
name: hashSeed

description: Wraps an HTML string in a Response with the right content type.
name: htmlResponse

untestabilityReason.justification: Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay scaffolded by the CMS CLI; runs only on Workers and is unused here (auth.worker is false)

description: The envelope enforced on the RESULT, not just the inputs. Sampling within bounded ranges is necessary but not sufficient: inside those ranges a seed can still grow every branch stopped early, a crown combed onto one side, or a bare limb the tree never reached. Checks branch count, segment count, aspect, canopy spread and horizontal balance.
name: isAcceptableTree

description: The Koch curve: every segment becomes four, turning 60 degrees either way.
name: kochPoints

description: Expands an axiom by applying production rules a given number of times. Symbols with no rule pass through unchanged, which is what lets the dragon curve carry its bookkeeping symbols.
name: lsystem

description: Encodes words as morse laid out left to right at classic proportions — dash three units, symbol gap one, letter gap three, word gap seven. Unencodable characters are skipped rather than guessed at.
name: morseLine

description: Draws the three sides of an open square — down the left, across, back up — so the spiral's largest frame never closes.
name: openRectPath

description: Distance outside an inclusive range, or zero within it. The primitive every proportion rule in treeShortfall is expressed in, so each rule contributes a comparable magnitude rather than a bare pass or fail — which is what lets the resample loop rank near-misses instead of picking arbitrarily.
name: outOfBand

description: Renders the password prompt page for a locked preview.
name: passwordFormPage

untestabilityReason.justification: Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay scaffolded by the CMS CLI; runs only on Workers and is unused here (auth.worker is false)

description: A fresh seed for the per-visit regrow, deliberately in the same unsigned 32-bit space hashSeed produces. If the two ranges drifted apart, trees grown in the browser would quietly become a different population from the trees grown at build time from a page slug.
name: randomTreeSeed

description: Reads and parses one editable JSON singleton from the resolved data root.
name: readSingleton

untestabilityReason.justification: a filesystem read; the root-resolution logic it depends on is covered by the contentRoot tests

description: The absolute content root the collections read from — the codeyam sandbox during a session, committed src/content in production.
name: resolveContentRoot

description: The absolute data root the settings and nav singletons read from, resolved the same way as the content root.
name: resolveDataRoot

description: Resolves a content or data root in precedence order: env override, then the .codeyam/tmp sidecar, then the committed default.
name: resolveRoot

description: Decides which seed a tree grows from. The precedence is the point: an explicit seed wins so the variations sheet can pin specific trees, otherwise the key is hashed, and a caller naming nothing falls back to one shared default tree rather than a random one, because an unseeded component should be stable across builds.
name: resolveTreeSeed

description: Trims float noise to two decimals so generated path data stays readable in devtools.
name: round

description: A deterministic mulberry32 generator. The site is static, so unseeded randomness would redraw every structure on every build and churn every committed screenshot; the same seed gives the same figure forever.
name: seededRandom

description: Samples one sine wave across a width at a fixed phase, so waves of differing amplitude and period share an origin. `fraction` stops the wave short of the frame — the incompleteness dial.
name: sinePath

description: Joins a list of points into an SVG polyline `d` attribute, rounding coordinates to two decimals so generated paths stay readable.
name: toPath

description: Builds the SVG transform string for one puzzle piece: a rotation about the mark's centre, plus an inset and scale for the four diagonal pieces.
name: transformFor

untestabilityReason.justification: formats a transform string from two arguments; the geometry it produces is covered by the Mark component scenarios

description: The bounding box of a grown tree — origin plus width and height, with a floor of one unit so a degenerate figure cannot produce a zero-sized box and divide by zero downstream. Shared by treeViewBox and the acceptance checks so the frame and the proportion rules are measured off exactly the same geometry.
name: treeBounds

description: The grown geometry alone, for every caller that only ever wanted the lines. Now exactly growTree(options).segments — kept as its own export so the signature the component and the five existing tree tests depend on did not have to move when growTree started returning branch counts alongside the segments.
name: treeSegments

description: How far a grown tree is from acceptable, as a single number — zero exactly when it passes every rule. A boolean is what callers want but is not enough to CHOOSE with: when no seed in the resample budget produces an acceptable tree, something still has to be drawn, and ranking the failures needs a magnitude. isAcceptableTree is derived from this, so the predicate and the ranking cannot drift apart.
name: treeShortfall

description: Maps an arbitrary seed onto one bounded parameter set drawn from TREE_ENVELOPE. Free-form randomisation of TreeOptions would eventually produce a bald stick or a shrub; sampling from declared ranges is what makes within some constraints a testable object rather than a hope.
name: treeVariant

description: The viewBox framing a grown tree, with a one-unit margin so the outermost stroke is not clipped. Extracted because BOTH the server render and the browser regrow need it; left inline in the component the two renders could silently drift into framing the same tree differently.
name: treeViewBox

description: Walks an L-system string as turtle graphics and returns the points visited. `fraction` walks only part of the forward moves, which is what makes a fragment a fragment.
name: turtle
